art_prompt: Small centered chest illustration of a satin ribbon bow perched on top of a barbell plate, clean minimal line art with soft pastel color fills, subtle shading, colors dusty rose, sage, cream, taupe, text stacked below the bow-and-barbell icon in bold lettering.
title: Bows On Bar Loaded Oversized Gym Shirt, Cute Lifting Club Tee, Pastel Workout Cover Up, Gift for Gym Girl
description:
Bow tied, bar loaded, personal record loading. This design pairs a sweet little ribbon icon with the unapologetically strong energy of loading the bar for another heavy set.

Boxy and oversized in soft sand cotton, it's made to be worn straight over a sports bra between sets or thrown on after leg day for the rest of the day.

Perfect for gifting the friend who color-codes her gym fits and still hits every PR on schedule.

Design created by our shop with the help of AI tools and printed on demand by our production partner.
risk_notes: Generic bow-and-barbell motif and wording, no protected marks or slogans referenced.
